verdict.rationale: The instructions are published openly on gov.uk guidance pages: the Innovator Founder, Skilled Worker and Global Talent pages set out eligibility, fees and processing times, which helps a founder prepare. The forms themselves are not offered as downloads; the founder route states "You must apply online," so only the guidance half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: downloadable application forms, evidence that guidance is offered as downloadable documents, and explicit confirmation that no account is needed to view it.
